turns.text: Let me check the departure board. Your train is delayed. It now leaves at 2:25.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: I see. So the delay is twenty-five minutes?

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Which platform should I use?

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.text: Platform 3. Please enter through Gate B.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: What is the new arrival time?

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.text: The expected arrival time is 6:10 this evening.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Thank you. I will wait near Gate B.

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.text: You're welcome. Please check the board again before boarding.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Do you have your ticket for the train to Hue?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Yes. I am checking the departure board now.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: What does it say?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: It shows a fifteen-minute delay.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: What is the new departure time?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: It is 4:10.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Which platform do we need?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Platform 5, through the north gate.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Does the delay change the arrival time too?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Yes. The new arrival time is 4:40.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay. We still have enough time.

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Good. Let's go to Platform 5 now.

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.text: Good morning. Where would you like to travel?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: I would like a ticket to Hue.

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.text: Certainly. I can book the next train for you.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: What time does it leave?

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.text: It leaves at 10:40.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Which platform does it leave from?

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.text: It leaves from Platform 2.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: When does boarding begin?

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.text: Boarding begins in ten minutes.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Thank you. I will go to Platform 2.

turns.speaker: Station Agent
turns.text: Hello. Which trip are you taking?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: I have a ticket to Quy Nhon.

turns.speaker: Station Agent
turns.text: Okay. What would you like to check?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Which platform does it leave from?

turns.speaker: Station Agent
turns.text: It leaves from Platform 7, through Gate C. The departure board has just been updated.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Is the train on time?

turns.speaker: Station Agent
turns.text: No. There is a fifteen-minute delay. The new departure time is 5:30.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: What time does boarding begin now?

turns.speaker: Station Agent
turns.text: Boarding begins at 5:15 at Gate C.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Thanks. I will wait near Gate C.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Good afternoon. Riverside Hotel. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: I would like to book a room for one guest.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Certainly. Which nights do you need the room?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Friday and Saturday nights. Do you have a room available?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Yes. We have a room available for those two nights.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Great. How much is it per night?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: The rate is seventy dollars per night.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Thank you. Is breakfast included?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Yes. Breakfast is included in the room rate.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Perfect. I would like to book it, please.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Hello. I need a room for two guests from Monday to Thursday.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Let me check. Yes, we have a room available for those three nights.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Great. What is the rate?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: It is ninety dollars per night.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Does that rate include breakfast?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Yes. Breakfast is included for both guests.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Great. Is the hotel close to the city center?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Yes. It is about a ten-minute walk.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: That works for us. I would like to book the room.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Certainly. I will prepare the reservation details.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Good evening. City Garden Hotel. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: I would like to book a room for two guests for three nights.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Certainly. What day are you arriving?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: I am arriving on Tuesday. How much is the room per night?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: We have a room available. The rate is ninety-five dollars per night.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: That sounds okay. Is breakfast included in the rate?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Yes. Breakfast is included for both guests. Is that rate okay for you?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Yes, that is within my budget. I would like to book the room.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Great. Shall I confirm the room for three nights from Tuesday?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Yes, please confirm it for me.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Good evening. Welcome to Lakeside Hotel.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Hello. I have a reservation.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Great. Can I see your passport?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Of course. Here it is.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Thank you. Your room is on the fifth floor. Here is your key.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Thank you. Where is the elevator?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: It is on your right, beside the lobby.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Great. What time is checkout tomorrow?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Checkout is at eleven.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Thank you for your help.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Good afternoon. Welcome to Central Hotel.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Hello. I have a reservation for two nights.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Certainly. Can I see your passport?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Yes. Here it is.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Thank you. Your room is on the third floor. Here is your key.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Thank you. Is the elevator near the lobby?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Yes. It is beside the front desk.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: One more question. What time is checkout tomorrow?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Checkout is at eleven tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Great. Thank you for your help.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Hello. I have a reservation for three nights under Emma Lee.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Welcome, Ms. Lee. May I see your passport, please?

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Yes. Here it is.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Thank you. Everything looks good. Your room is 602, on the sixth floor.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Great. Where is the elevator?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: It is behind you, near the lobby.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Thank you. What time is checkout on my last day?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Checkout is at noon.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Perfect. May I have the room key, please?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Of course. Here is your key. Enjoy your stay.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Good evening. Welcome to Ocean Hotel. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Hello. I have a reservation for two nights.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Certainly. What name is the reservation under?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: It is under Minh Tran.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Thank you. I found your booking. May I see your passport?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Yes. Here is my passport.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Thank you. Your room is on the fourth floor. Here is your key.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Thank you. Where is the elevator from here?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: The elevator is beside the lobby.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Great. What time is checkout on my last day?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Checkout is at eleven.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Thank you. I have everything I need now.

turns.speaker: Hotel Clerk
turns.text: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Yes. I have a reservation for two nights under Minh Tran.

turns.speaker: Hotel Clerk
turns.text: I found your reservation. May I see your passport?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Of course. Here is my passport.

turns.speaker: Hotel Clerk
turns.text: Thank you. Your room is 805, on the eighth floor. Here is your key.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Thank you. Where is the elevator?

turns.speaker: Hotel Clerk
turns.text: It is across from the front desk.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Great. What time is checkout on my last day?

turns.speaker: Hotel Clerk
turns.text: Checkout is at noon.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Perfect. Thank you for your help.

turns.speaker: Support Agent
turns.text: Hello. Travel Support. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: My flight is delayed by two hours. I already contacted the airline.

turns.speaker: Support Agent
turns.text: I see. Did they give you a new departure time?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Yes. The new departure time is 6:30 this evening.

turns.speaker: Support Agent
turns.text: Okay. Do you need help with anything else?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Yes. I have a car booked to take me to the airport. Can you change the time?

turns.speaker: Support Agent
turns.text: Of course. I can change it to 4:30.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Great. Thank you for your help.

turns.speaker: Support Agent
turns.text: Hello. Travel Support. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: My luggage is missing. I already spoke to the hotel front desk.

turns.speaker: Support Agent
turns.text: I am sorry. What did they tell you?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: They looked for my bag, but they could not find it.

turns.speaker: Support Agent
turns.text: Where did you leave it?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: I left it at the hotel desk this morning.

turns.speaker: Support Agent
turns.text: Okay. I can contact the hotel manager and ask them to look again.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Thank you. Who should I contact if they still cannot find it?

turns.speaker: Support Agent
turns.text: You can contact the police station nearby. I can give you the phone number.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: That would help. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: I would like to cancel my next flight.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Of course. May I ask why?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: My last flight was delayed, and one of my bags did not arrive.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I am sorry. Did any of your luggage arrive?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Yes. One bag arrived, but it is damaged.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I understand. Please contact the baggage desk first. They can help you with both bags.

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Okay. Can I come back here to cancel my flight after that?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Yes. Bring your ticket back, and I can help you cancel it.

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: All right. I will go to the baggage desk first, then come back here.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That is fine. I will be here when you return.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Excuse me. My next flight has been canceled.

turns.speaker: Airline Agent
turns.text: I am sorry. Let me check the next available flight for you.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Thank you. When is the next flight?

turns.speaker: Airline Agent
turns.text: There is one at 6:20 from Gate B4.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Great. I also have a problem with my luggage.

turns.speaker: Airline Agent
turns.text: What happened to it?

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: One suitcase arrived, but it is damaged.

turns.speaker: Airline Agent
turns.text: Please take it to the baggage service desk near Carousel 4.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Okay. I will go there now. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Airline Agent
turns.text: You are welcome.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Good evening. This is the front desk. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: The air conditioner in my room doesn't work, and the room is getting very warm.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: I am sorry about that. What room are you in?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: I am in room 407. Could you send someone to check it, please?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Of course. I can send someone up in about fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Thank you. What can I do if they cannot fix it tonight?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: We can move you to another room if they cannot fix it.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: That would be great. I would like another room if the problem cannot be fixed.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Certainly. We will take care of it for you.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Thank you very much. I will wait in my room for now.

turns.speaker: Travel Desk Agent
turns.text: Hello. How can I help with your trip today?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: My connecting flight was canceled, and I need help finding another flight today.

turns.speaker: Travel Desk Agent
turns.text: I can help you with that. Do you have your ticket with you?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Yes, I have my ticket here. I also have a problem with one of my suitcases.

turns.speaker: Travel Desk Agent
turns.text: What happened to your suitcase?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: It arrived with me, but it is damaged on one side. Who should I contact about it?

turns.speaker: Travel Desk Agent
turns.text: You can go to Baggage Services after we change your flight.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Okay, thank you. What is the next available flight for me?

turns.speaker: Travel Desk Agent
turns.text: There is one at 6:20 from Gate B4.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: That flight works for me. Can you change my ticket to that flight?

turns.speaker: Travel Desk Agent
turns.text: Yes, I can. Baggage Services is near Carousel 4.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Great. I will go there after this. Thank you for helping me with both problems.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: Welcome to the travel center. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: I would like a ticket to Hue. What time does the next train leave?

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: The next train to Hue leaves at 2:30 from Platform 2.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: I heard there may be a delay. Is that train on time?

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: No. There is a twenty-minute delay, but it still leaves from Platform 2.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Okay. Thank you. I will wait near Platform 2.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Good evening. Welcome to the hotel. Do you have a reservation?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Yes. I have a reservation for two nights under Minh Tran.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Thank you. May I see your passport, please?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Of course. Here it is.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Everything looks good. Your room is 506. Here is your key.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: Hello. Welcome to the travel center at the station. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: I would like a ticket to Hue. What time does the next train leave?

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: The next train leaves at 3:15. Would you like a ticket for that train?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Yes, please. But I cannot find one of my bags. I think I left it near Platform 2.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: The station baggage desk can help you. It is next to Platform 2.

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Thank you. I will go there now and ask about my bag.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: Did you find your bag?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Yes, I did. Thank you. Is there a hotel near the station? I also need a hotel room for two nights.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: Yes, there is. I can book a room at a hotel near the station. Is the room for one guest?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Yes, just one guest. How much is it per night?

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: It is seventy dollars per night. Would you like me to book it?

turns.speaker: Minh
turns.text: Yes, please book the room for me.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: My train to Da Nang is delayed by thirty minutes.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: The new departure time is 4:00 from Platform 6.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: I have a hotel reservation for tonight. I may arrive later than I planned.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: What time did you tell the hotel you would arrive?

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Around six, but now I will probably arrive after seven.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: You should call the hotel and tell them about the delay.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Good idea. I do not want them to cancel my reservation.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: They can keep the room for you if they know you are arriving late.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Thank you. I will call the hotel before I board the train.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: You're welcome. Your train still leaves from Platform 6.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Do you have your ticket for the train to Hue?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Yes, but the train is delayed by twenty minutes.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Which platform do we need?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Platform 4. After we arrive, we should go straight to the hotel.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Do you have the room reservation?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Yes. The confirmation is on my phone.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Great. Is all your luggage with you?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Yes. I have both bags with me.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Perfect. We have everything for the trip.

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Good. Let's go to Platform 4 and wait for the train.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: Welcome to the travel center. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: I would like to travel to Hue this afternoon. What time does the next train leave?

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: The next train leaves at 1:45 and arrives in Hue at 4:20.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: That works for me. I would like one ticket, and I also need a hotel room for two nights.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: Certainly. How many guests will be staying in the room?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Just one guest. Is there a hotel near the station?

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: Yes. Riverside Hotel is nearby. The rate is seventy dollars per night, including breakfast.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: That sounds good. Please book the room for two nights.

turns.speaker: Travel Agent
turns.text: Certainly. Your train ticket and hotel room are both booked.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Great. Thank you. Now I have everything ready for my trip.

turns.speaker: Trip Assistant
turns.text: Hello. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: My train to Nha Trang was canceled, and I need another train for tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: Trip Assistant
turns.text: I can help with that. There is a train at 9:10 tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: That time works for me. Which platform does the train leave from?

turns.speaker: Trip Assistant
turns.text: It leaves from Platform 3. The ticket is twenty-five dollars.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: That is fine. Does the train arrive before noon?

turns.speaker: Trip Assistant
turns.text: Yes. It arrives in Nha Trang at 11:45.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Great. Please book that train for me.

turns.speaker: Trip Assistant
turns.text: Certainly. Your new ticket is ready.

turns.speaker: Bạn
turns.text: Thank you. I will be at Platform 3 before nine.
